system:
You are diagnosing why one merchant's payment
success rate is below what their category achieves. Before answering, you
may look things up.

Ask for ONE lookup at a time. You will be shown the result, then may ask
again. The budget is small, so ask for what would actually change your
mind rather than for what confirms what you already believe.

Stop as soon as you have enough. Stopping early is a good outcome.

Reply with JSON and nothing else, one of:
  {"tool": "name", "args": {...}, "why": "what this would tell you"}
  {"done": true, "why": "what you now believe and what convinced you"}
prompt:
CONTEXT
MERCHANT
  name: Chai Point
  mcc: 5814 (food)
  transactions this month: 6200
  average ticket: Rs 886.83

SUCCESS RATE
  observed:            91.73%
  cohort achievable:   91.66%
  gap:                 -0.07 points

DECOMPOSITION (Shapley, points of the gap)
  bank          +0.00 pts +/- 0.57 measured error   [INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  method        -0.02 pts +/- 0.57 measured error   [NOT IDENTIFIED - merchant has effectively one value here; INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  hour          -0.01 pts +/- 0.57 measured error   [INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  amount_band   -0.02 pts +/- 0.58 measured error   [INSIDE ITS OWN ERROR BAR]
  residual      -0.01 pts   [unexplained residual]
  process_gap   +1.65 pts   [process gap, computed directly, NOT decomposed]

MERCHANT BANK MIX vs NPCI NATIONAL DATA (period 2025-08)
  bank                              share   NPCI BD%%  NPCI TD%%  approved%%
  State Bank of India               29.0%     5.92     0.42     93.66
  HDFC Bank Ltd.                     8.5%     4.63     0.01     95.37
  Bank of Baroda                     7.6%     8.50     0.05     91.44
  Union Bank of India                6.4%     7.02     0.75     92.23
  Punjab National Bank               5.8%     8.61     0.19     91.20
  Kotak Mahindra Bank                5.7%     7.47     0.13     92.39

HOUR DISTRIBUTION (share of payments)

TOOLS
  factor_breakdown(factor) -- Volume share and failure rate for every value of a factor. factor: bank | method | hour | amount_band
  bank_vs_npci(bank) -- This merchant's failure rate on one issuer against NPCI's published national figures for it. bank: exact bank name
  failure_examples(factor, value) -- Real failed payments matching a factor value, with their error codes. factor: bank|method|hour|amount_band, value: the value
  attribution_with_error(factor) -- What the decomposition attributes to a factor, beside its own measured error. factor: bank | method | hour | amount_band

ASKED SO FAR
  (nothing yet)
text: {"done": true, "why": "The gap between Chai Point's observed success rate (91.73%) and the cohort achievable rate (91.66%) is only -0.07 percentage points. Every single Shapley component (bank, method, hour, amount_band) is inside its own error bar of ~±0.57 points, meaning none are statistically distinguishable from zero. The residual is -0.01 pts. The only notable item is a +1.65 pt process gap, which means Chai Point is actually *outperforming* what its mix of banks/methods/hours/amounts would predict — it has better-than-expected processing. The bottom line: there is no meaningful underperformance to diagnose. The -0.07 pt gap is within noise (well under 1/10th of the measurement error on any single factor), and no lookup would change this conclusion."}
